messages.author: ecb7e78da7cf0bfd
messages.subject: fortify
parts:
I am trying to make a choropleth on a world map (map taken from cshape). I am getting the following error with fortify.

> world <- cshp(date=as.Date("2012-1-1"),useGW=F)
> world2 <- fortify(world,region="COWCODE")
Error: isTRUE(gpclibPermitStatus()) is not TRUE

Would appreciate any help.

Vikas

library(sp)
library(ggplot2)
library(cshapes)

world <- cshp(date=as.Date("2012-1-1"),useGW=F)
world2 <- fortify(world,region="COWCODE")
